mboh...@shout.net wrote:
>
> What is the current method for getting tournament sanctioning from
> WotC (including prize support) and V:EKN?

I guess the DCI's announcement wasn't clear enough, eh? The DCI has
resumed complete sanctioning of V:TES. V:EKN acts in an advisory role
but does not have anything to do with the actual sanctioning anymore.
Contact Linda Roberts at the DCI at lin...@wizards.com

> The V:EKN web page
> isn't very clear...heck, it doesn't even have the new DCI rules.

The new DCI rules are effective 9/1/98. Don't rush me! :-) I just
added them on 8/14 as well as the latest DCI sanctioning forms and
instructions.
